svg.title: Fixed forecast calibration diagnostics
svg.desc: PL · xgboost · 231 reused holdout matches · model and calibration maps fixed Arrows show observed frequency minus predicted mean; lengths are unscaled. Circle area is proportional to bin count. Top panels: axis resolution B=10; only cells with at least 10 matches shown. Joint TV uses every match, including hidden cells. Bottom: marginal ECE averages three scalar errors; it is a different statistic from joint total variation (TV). Descriptive estimates without intervals or calibration certificate · run 6b85b4c2d5494d65 Open circle: mean prediction → orange point: observed class frequencies
